_meanings:
.²1 To cause to know, make known, inform, acquaint with.
.²2 To teach, communicate, impart.
.²3 To advise, admonish; {#boDayantaM hitAhitam#} <ls>Bk. 8. 82</ls>;

 {#maccittA madgataprARA boDayantaH parasparam#} <ls>Bg. 10. 9</ls>.
.²4 To revive, restore to life, bring to senses or consciousness.
.²5 To remind, put in mind of; {#smarizyati tvAM na sa boDito'pi san#} <ls>Ś. 4. 1</ls>.
.²6 To wake up, rouse, excite (<ab>fig.</ab>); {#akAle boDito BrAtrA#} <ls>R. 12. 81</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 75</ls>.
.²7 To revive the scent (of a perfume).
.²8 To cause to expand, open; {#maDurayA maDuboDitamADavI#} <ls>Śi. 6. 20</ls>;
 {#savitA boDayati paNkajAnyeva#} <ls>Ś. 5. 28</ls>.
.²9 To signify, convey, indicate.
